testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-user-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23086 sales rep popup lists only reps of the selected store

scenario.summary: With sales reps on store A and store B and a user of store A, the admin opens Manage User with store A selected and opens the Sales Rep popup: only store A's sales rep is listed, store B's is not.
steps: Go to Accounts and Users > Users; search the user of store A (@user.userName) and click Manage.
Ensure store A is selected in the Store Name dropdown.
Click the search icon next to Sales Rep; search the popup for @rep.fullName and @repB.fullName.
assertions: @repB.fullName is not listed (No records found. when searched)
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 2 and answers in section 6.
FSD 'Store Assignment Rules for Sales Rep' and 'Salesrep selection popup': only sales reps of the selected store.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Store B: STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE with exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId and no store (optional params from change proposal 7a, analysis.md; pending approval): any other active webstore.
Sales rep of store B: SALES_REP_OF_STORE with store = @storeB.storeCode (STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE query output storeCode).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
